apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: vote
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-credentials
  namespace: vote
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: postgres
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: db-data
  namespace: vote
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: redis-healthcheck
  namespace: vote
data:
  redis.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: postgres-healthcheck
  namespace: vote
data:
  postgres.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    pg_isready -U postgres
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: redis
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          volumeMounts:
            - name: healthchecks
              mountPath: /healthchecks
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh", "/healthchecks/redis.sh"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh", "/healthchecks/redis.sh"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
      volumes:
        - name: healthchecks
          configMap:
            name: redis-healthcheck
            defaultMode: 0755
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: redis
spec:
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: db
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: db
          image: postgres:15-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: db-credentials
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: healthchecks
              mountPath: /healthchecks
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh", "/healthchecks/postgres.sh"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh", "/healthchecks/postgres.sh"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
      volumes:
        - name: db-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: db-data
        - name: healthchecks
          configMap:
            name: postgres-healthcheck
            defaultMode: 0755
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: db
spec:
  selector:
    app: db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: vote
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vote
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: vote
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_vote
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: redis
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vote
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: vote
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: vote
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: result
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: result
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: result
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: result
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_result
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_HOST
              value: db
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 15
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: result
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: result
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: result
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8081
      targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: vote
  labels:
    app: worker
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: dockersamples/examplevotingapp_worker
          env:
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: redis
            - name: POSTGRES_HOST
              value: db
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
